evidence: The XRR patterns show clear thickness oscillations in all cases, indicating the good homogeneity of the films and the quality of the top and bottom interfaces. The XRR pattern of the film with 15 repetitions shows its superlattice signature peak at about 7.1/C14 , corresponding to a period of 12 A˚, which is approximately the size of two unit cells in SiO 2 and GeO2 crystalline polymorphs. The model roughness values are in agreement with those determined by AFM (RMS roughness).
